summary: Show the birds heard by BirdNET-Go on your Mac or Linux computer.
page_description: A quiet offline viewer for bird collages detected and rendered on your own computer.
release_notes: The collage now changes on its own while the reader is watching, instead of waiting to be asked for a refresh.

steps.text: Run BirdNET-Go and Fugleramme on a Mac or Linux computer with a microphone.
Start the companion through the existing owner-attended SSH path.
